theme_compositions.notes: The E1 application role makes the downstream access decision over commissioned service capacity, so it composes the D4 canonical L4 service-capacity validation node. The D4 L3 in_orbit_infrastructure_operations node remains the narrative operating context; fleet control, platform operations, canonical company mappings, and infrastructure evidence remain owned by satellite_manufacturing_space_infrastructure.

The E1 application role configures access, activation, provisioning, and terrestrial handoff around satellite-specific gateway and terminal hardware; D4 retains canonical equipment ownership and evidence.
The E1 application role owns downstream customer service delivery and utilization while the D4 canonical target retains commissioned-capacity and infrastructure-revenue validation ownership.

The E1 application role processes and distributes earth-observation data produced by payload hardware; satellite sensors, payload electronics, platform integration, and their company evidence remain owned by D4.
